newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault confirms in British parts talks.
newsitem.headline: Renault confirms in British parts talks.

text.p: French carmaker Renault is in talks with British car parts suppliers but cannot say whether the talks are close to producing an accord, a spokeswoman for the company said on Monday.
Renault "confirms having talks with British parts makers", the spokeswoman said.
The Financial Times reported on Monday that Renault was in talks with more than 40 car parts suppliers in an effort to drive down costs.
"We have regular prospecting missions all over the world and we have contacted a certain number of companies in the United Kingdom," the spokeswoman added.
Renault buys about 60 billion francs of parts a year, of which about 75 percent comes from French-based companies.
"The choice of Renault's suppliers is made as a function of several criteria: quality, cost, international dimension, capacity for innovation and financial health," she added.
